name: Adventurer Buffer
author: Khaos
description: Town support with owner-configured Basic, Mid or editable Custom buffs.

name: Arena Dueling
author: sateriok
description: Phantoms hang out at the town PvP arenas and spar. Walk in and one of your own class challenges you to a duel, or call a duel by class yourself, optionally for an adena stake.

name: Auto Potions
author: sateriok
description: Toggle automatic potion use with .pots. Drinks CP, HP and MP potions when each falls under a percent you set, using Quick and Greater Healing Potions together on their own timers, with fallbacks when you run out.

name: Beast Collar Taming
author: HumblePie
description: Collar-bound individual pets: capture validation, per-collar rolled profiles, rarity, growth, affinity, temperament, imprint, inherited skills, two-stage awakening, collar-bound equipment and a collar passport UI with a wear state. Gives every collar its own private NPC id so the stock pet code resolves the right individual and patches no core files. Reagents are sold by a store opened by double-clicking the granted catalogue item or by .tamestore; the page is generated in code because module HTML files are never loaded. See MODLOG.md.

name: Bot Control Menu
author: justneedair
description: HTML menu that sends party-chat commands to Living World phantoms when a button is pressed

name: Bot Summon Menus
author: justneedair
description: Three voiced menus (.lfclass, .lfrole, .lfbuff) that shout LF for one bot at a time.

name: Buff Limits
author: Sateriok
description: Sets 2-hour durations on buffer-NPC buffs and on perma-uptime class self buffs like War Cry. Burst skills such as Frenzy are untouched. Applied in memory at startup; no files edited.

name: Class Master
author: Sateriok
description: Adds a class master NPC that changes a player's profession at levels 20, 40 and 76, with an adena price for each change.

name: Craft Master
author: Sateriok
description: Adds a Craft Master NPC that crafts any item at a 100% success rate when you bring the recipe item and the normal materials. The recipe item is used up.

name: Craft Master (No Recipe)
author: Sateriok
description: Adds a Craft Master NPC that crafts any item in the game at a 100% success rate from materials alone, no recipe needed.

name: Drop Tracker
author: sateriok
description: Benchmark tool: .drops start / stop / status records kills per monster, XP and SP, adena, seal stones, Ancient Adena and every item gained across the whole party, and reports per-hour rates.

name: GM Shop Full
author: Sateriok
description: Adds a Giran merchant with a menu: weapons, armor and jewelry by grade, raid boss jewels, and consumables with enchant and augment supplies.

name: GM Shop Lite
author: Sateriok
description: Adds a Giran merchant that sells shots, everyday consumables and cosmetic accessories.

name: Hunting
author: sateriok
description: Community Board tab with Extermination Contracts (hunt each named hunting ground once) and Bounties (one per raid boss, with a bonus for clearing a level range), paid in adena. Progress survives restarts.

name: Phantom Encounters
author: sateriok
description: PvP danger: phantoms occasionally come for you in the field and fight you once. Five kinds from a wimp that asks if you are a bot to the AssMuncher, each with its own timer, strength and adena reward. Optional Contested Farming Zones: kills in popular hunting grounds can bring a phantom who claims the spot.

name: Pocket Shop
author: HumblePie
description: A shop that opens from an item in every player's bag, so you can sell your own items (custom ones included) without placing an NPC. Other modules can link to it or list their items in it. Stock and prices are set in module.ini.

name: Preset Buffer
author: Sateriok
description: Adds a Giran NPC that gives a full fighter or mage buff preset in one click.

name: PvP Events
author: sateriok
description: Start a PvP event with bots from the Community Board: free-for-all, King of the Hill, team deathmatch, Korean-style one-at-a-time, duels and 9v9, or watch bots fight. Scenario presets with roles and classes, kill scoring, respawns, a results table with kills and damage, and you are put back where you stood.

name: Quest Book
author: sateriok
description: Community Board tab: every quest by minimum level, who gives it (click to mark the NPC on your map), monsters involved, rewards, and your progress.

name: Recipe Book
author: sateriok
description: Community Board tab: every craftable recipe you can actually obtain (monster drop or quest reward), ingredient have/need counts, where each ingredient drops, and a personal goal list with a combined shopping list.

name: World Tuner
author: sateriok
description: Scales monster respawn times and spawn counts for the whole world, a level range, chosen regions or single monsters, from one config file. Raid bosses, minions, instances and quest spawns are left alone.
